target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew accepts this species as Texas-native, but USDA Forest Service and NPSOT place its Texas native distribution in East Texas / Gulf Coastal Plain / bottomland regions rather than the project target-zone counties. No 3 target-zone counties are locked.
target_zone_range.guardrail: State-level Texas nativity and cultivated Central Texas landscape records do not satisfy the project county rule.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the leaves: willow oak has narrow linear-lanceolate, willow-like leaves with entire margins and a tiny bristle tip, plus small saucer-cupped acorns.
diagnostic_traits: small acorn in shallow saucer-like cup
East Texas/Gulf Coastal Plain native emphasis
